'''Republic Sienar Systems''' was the predecessor to [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] and was founded during the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by the [[Sienar family/Legends|Sienar family]].

It funded the [[Allied Tion Historical Society]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the company supplied numerous vehicles to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], much to the disdain of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].

Shortly before [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] took control, the Senate ordered the dissolution of Republic Sienar Systems. The company's holdings were also absorbed by the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]].

However, the Emperor revived the company as Sienar Fleet Systems and placed it under the control of [[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar]]. Sienar Fleet Systems would later become one of the most important and prolific [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] manufacturers.
